verdict.rationale: Workable ships a built-in 'Workable Agent' that autonomously runs top-of-funnel sourcing, screening, and qualifying tasks and hands back an interview-ready shortlist, plus AI-generated candidate recommendations included in all plans — both are delegate-to-AI-assistant capabilities embedded in the product itself. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of how users configure/instruct the agent (task delegation UX), and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond first-party marketing copy.
